The '''2023–24 FIS Cross-Country World Cup''', organized by the [[International Ski Federation]] (FIS) was the 43rd [[FIS Cross-Country World Cup|World Cup]] in [[cross-country skiing (sport)|cross-country skiing]] for men and women.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fis-ski.com/en/cross-country|title=FIS Cross-Country|website=www.fis-ski.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Rules for the FIS Cross Countrz World Cup Edition 2023/24|url=https://assets.fis-ski.com/image/upload/fis-prod/assets/1_World_Cup_Rules_Cross-Country2024_full.pdf|access-date=10 November 2023|website=fis-ski.com}}</ref> 

The season started on 24 November 2023 in [[Rukatunturi|Ruka]], Finland, and concluded on 17 March 2024 in [[Falun]], Sweden.<ref>{{cite web|title=FIS Cross-Country World Cup 2023/24|url=https://assets.fis-ski.com/image/upload/fis-prod/assets/WC_Calendar_CC_2023-24.pdf|publisher=fis-ski.com|access-date=2 November 2023}}</ref>

[[Johannes Høsflot Klæbo]] (men's) and [[Tiril Udnes Weng]] (women's), both of Norway, were the reigning champions from the [[2022–23 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|previous season]]. However, they did not defend their title.

[[Harald Østberg Amundsen]] from Norway and [[Jessie Diggins]] from United States, became the new overall champions.

In October 2023, FIS decided to prolong the suspension of the Russian and Belarusian national team from competitions due to the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Decisions of the FIS Council Fall 2023|url=https://www.fis-ski.com/en/international-ski-federation/news-multimedia/news-2022/decisions-of-the-fis-council-fall-2023|publisher=fis-ski.com|access-date=25 October 2023}}</ref> 

With a stop at the [[2024 Stifel Loppet Cup]] in Minneapolis, the season featured the first World Cup event in the United States in 23 years.<ref>{{cite web|title=Minnesota to host 1st World Cup XC ski event in US since '01|website=[[Associated Press News]] |date=15 February 2023 |url=https://apnews.com/article/sports-mexico-national-soccer-team-jessie-diggins-minnesota-covid-6dff348e948c94a9bd758d1275956bf3|access-date=15 February 2024}}</ref>

==Retirements==
{{col-begin}}
{{col-2}}
;Men
*{{flagicon|FRA}} [[Maurice Manificat]]<ref>{{Citation |url=https://www.fondoitalia.it/2024/03/06/mobile/leggi-notizia/argomenti/sci-di-fondo/articolo/sci-di-fondo-maurice-manificat-dice-addio-alla-coppa-del-mondo-la-50km-di-holmenkollen-sara-la-s.html |title=Sci di fondo - Maurice Manificat dice addio alla Coppa del Mondo: La 50km di Holmenkollen sarà la sua ultima gara |date=6 March 2024 }}</ref>
*{{flagicon|NOR}} [[Daniel Stock]]<ref>{{Citation |url=https://www.langrenn.com/langrenn-allround/norsk-langrennsprofil-legger-opp-2/ |title=Norsk langrennsprofil legger opp |date=20 March 2024 }}</ref>
